mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.category, b.title, b.content, b.count, b.like_count, COALESCE(c.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count, b.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(b.create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str FROM board b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT board_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM board_comment GROUP BY board_id ) c ON c.board_id = b.board_id WHERE b.is_hidden = FALSE AND b.category <> 'trade' AND b.create_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) ORDER BY ( COALESCE(b.like_count, 0) * 5 + COALESCE(c.comment_count, 0) * 3 + COALESCE(b.count, 0) / 20 ) DESC, b.create_at DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT b.board_id, b.category, b.title, b.content, b.count, b.like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment bc WHERE bc.board_id = b.board_id) AS comment_count, b.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(b.create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str FROM board b WHERE b.is_hidden = FALSE AND b.category <> 'trade' AND b.create_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY b.count DESC, b.create_at DESC LIMIT #{size}
